review:
A 6x5 underground cluster game where five or more touching jewels win. The signature feature is the elevator nudge: after every spin, the reels can randomly nudge up or down to make more wins.

Wilds landing during nudges carry random 1x to 10x multipliers, and four to six bonus symbols trigger free spins. Every spin feels like it could still turn into a win after the reels stop. 96.53% RTP.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
